cp.$fn: function cp(id,T){const s=shomate[id]; if(!s||!Number.isFinite(T))return null; const r=s.ranges.find(x=>T>=x.T[0]&&T<=x.T[1]); if(!r)return null; const t=T/1000; return r.A+r.B*t+r.C*t*t+r.D*t*t*t+r.E/(t*t);}
